## About

Zaw Lin Naing is a results-driven full-stack software engineer with over 7 years of professional experience building reliable, scalable, and maintainable web applications. He specialises in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem across both frontend and backend, with strong depth in cloud infrastructure, microservices architecture, and AI/LLM integration. He effectively leverages AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to boost productivity and code quality.

## Projects

### AI Review CLI
**Type**: Open Source
**Repository**: https://github.com/zawlinnnaing/ai-review-cli
**Technologies**: TypeScript, Node.js
An open-source command-line tool that enables AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to perform automated code reviews on GitLab Merge Requests. It handles GitLab authentication, diff fetching, line number annotation, and posts structured inline comments. Ships as an npm package and pre-built binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

### Zen Mode Extension
**Type**: Open Source / Chrome Extension
**Repository**: https://github.com/zen-suite/focus-mode-extension
**Store**: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/zen-mode-block-distractio/cblailchdcmjcjjklmninjaoifijfdmg
**Technologies**: TypeScript, React, Vite
A Chrome extension that blocks up to 5000 domains to minimise distractions and boost productivity during web browsing. Includes a search function to temporarily unblock specific sites.

### Zen Player
**Type**: Open Source / Mobile App
**Repository**: https://github.com/zawlinnnaing/zen-player
**Technologies**: Flutter
A cross-platform video player (web and Android) designed to reduce time wasted on YouTube by supporting intentional video queues with looping.

### Portfolio Website
**Repository**: https://github.com/zawlinnnaing/zawlinnnaing.github.io
**Technologies**: Gatsby.js, Tailwind CSS, GitHub Pages
This portfolio website, built with Gatsby.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed automatically via GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages.

### TensorFlow Implementation of CAN (Graduation Thesis)
**Repository**: https://github.com/zawlinnnaing/CAN-thesis
**Article**: https://medium.com/@zawlinnnaing0018/creating-new-art-works-by-integrating-creative-adversarial-network-can-and-neural-style-bed8aa51fb3a
**Technologies**: Python, TensorFlow
Graduation thesis implementing a Creative Adversarial Network (CAN) using TensorFlow to generate artwork trained on an art styles dataset. Enhanced the model for higher-resolution image generation and simplified the training setup for Google Colab.
